gaps.name: Full Moduli Variety Classification
gaps.description: Classify every 6x6 CHM that can be a transition matrix of a MUB triple. The earlier target, membership in {F6, B6(theta), K6^(3), S6, H6}, is not a known classification; the 2026-10-11 checkpoint quarantined it in favour of the finite-corner classification (D-external).
gaps.approach_a: Literature formalization: construct Cyc24 reps for each literature class, verify via classify_orbit
gaps.approach_b: Algebraic elimination: Groebner basis on 55-poly / 50-var ideal over Q(zeta_24)
gaps.approach_c: Matolcsi, Matszangosz, Varga, Weiner et al., published version doi:10.1007/s10801-026-01506-x: Conjecture 2 (Hadamard cube identity), Conjecture 3 (Szollosi family X(alpha) in no MUB quadruplet) and Proposition 4.2 (Conjectures 2 and 3 imply at most three MUBs in C^6). The arXiv v1 2503.14752 has Conjectures 1 and 2 only.

gaps.name: Candidate Representation Bridge
gaps.description: MUB quadruple -> tested block matrices + PSD preservation
gaps.note: Supplied finite-model data and semantic/coverage contracts remain required; see papers/mub6_claim_ledger.md. SzollosiQuartetSystem checks actual variable third/fourth bases over the constructed phase family, all 144 candidate coordinates and a rational half-unit containing box. This does not supply chart equivalence transport or an exclusion certificate. SzollosiQuadraticSystem supplies a noncomputable joint rational quadratic specification with 440 real variables, 618 equations, two-way actual quartet semantics and a complete solution-containing rational box. SzollosiExecutableSystem now exports all expressions with checked real polynomial semantics and complete IDs. Native replay matched 1854 rational probe values and returned UNRESOLVED_FULL_BOX with 618 intervals. SzollosiIntervalExclusion checks AST interval enclosure and zero-exclusion soundness; its full-box check is false and its reflected phase-interior example is off domain. The current emitted 618 coefficient rows and 618 intervals have kernel-checked polynomial identity and real enclosure semantics. RectangularQuadraticExclusion now derives exact midpoint secant and formal derivative bounds, zero retention in the rectangular image and strict-separation exclusion. SzollosiRectangularExclusion derives actual-table shape and leaf/full-box implications with all 618 equations and 440 coordinates. The actual full-box native rectangular data now has kernel-checked 618-row Jacobian and 440-image semantics. It narrows 24 coordinates of the constructed first family matrix, leaves all 144 additional-basis coordinates unchanged and excludes none. Generic compiler/decoder qualification for later inputs, useful preconditioners/subdivision, successful quartet-domain checks, full cover, cusp analysis and emptiness remain open.

gaps.name: Analytic Parameter Variation Enclosures
gaps.description: Rigorous matrix derivative estimates along continuous families
gaps.lean4_target: Scoped Targets B1-B3; full CHM parameter variation remains open
gaps.note: B1-B3 receipts cover their stated continuous curve, finite nerve, and 28-cell partition; they do not certify parameter variation over all 6x6 CHM moduli. Linear interpolation mu(t) = (1-t)mu_A + t mu_B >= min(mu_A, mu_B) between certified endpoints certifies convex combinations of endpoint margins only, and bounds no matrix derivative or curvature wall along a family. SzollosiTwoCirculant now constructs the full four-phase block family and six real equations in eight coordinates, with phase-sum image coverage, cubic identities and a rational unit box. No interval derivative, complete subdivision or cusp exclusion is derived.

gaps.name: Projector-Moment Positivity
gaps.description: Full Lasserre Q3/Q4 hierarchy for generic candidates
gaps.note: ConcreteMubFlatExtension now connects normalized positive flat real coordinate moments with finite compatibility for all 180 residuals to an actual unitary fourth-basis candidate. CommutativeFlatMoments constructs symmetric commuting coordinate operators and a common real zero from actual Gram/rank data. Evaluation at an actual solution supplies rank-one positive flat moments, yielding a two-way existence equivalence. Empty variety excludes positive semidefiniteness under normalization, actual flatness and finite compatibility. Variety emptiness, full parameterized-family coverage and exclusion of arbitrary nonflat truncations remain open. The separate complex word extraction retains its dimension-six/rank-one/MU and star-algebra limits; the legacy weak interface still admits the zero-action countermodel.

open_residuals.name: Full 6x6 CHM exhaustion (ENC-1147)
open_residuals.note: Not a certificate. MasterClassification.lean:1071-1086 sets segre_g_sep = segre_f_sep - 1/1000 with segre_f_sep = (1 - 1/1000) * sigma0 + circle_defect and sigma0 a sum of squares of the slice equations, so g_sep = -1/1000 on the slice by construction. The Stengle identity is valid but refutes a condition chosen to fail. The slice is a 4-variable set; the 55 CHM equations do not enter. research/subgap_r7_adversarial_audit_note.md says the same. See research/mub6_review_and_next_derivation.md.
